idf_component_register(
    SRC_DIRS
        "."
        "real"
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "pub"
    PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS
        "real"
    REQUIRES
        driver fatfs
)

# Block warnings natively generated by the legacy Helix codebase
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wno-unused-but-set-variable)
